label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Call to Action (CTA)
body: A Call to Action (CTA) is an instruction designed to prompt an immediate response from your audience, guiding them to take a specific next step.
caption:
Think of a CTA as a friendly nudge for your audience, like "Shop Now," "Learn More," or "Download Your Guide." It helps people understand what to do next on your website or social post. Make your CTAs clear and easy to spot, so your potential customers know exactly how to engage with your offerings. Give it a try on your next post! 👇
